indexes.expression: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auth_invites_pending_tenant_email_uidx ON public.auth_invites USING btree (tenant_id, email) WHERE ((status)::text = 'pending'::text)
CREATE INDEX auth_sessions_family_index ON public.auth_sessions USING btree (family_id) WHERE (family_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX auth_users_custom_role_index ON public.auth_users USING btree (custom_role_id) WHERE (custom_role_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX auth_users_fullname_trgm_idx ON public.auth_users USING gin (((profile ->> 'fullName'::text)) gin_trgm_ops) WHERE (profile IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX billing_quotations_live_key ON public.billing_quotations USING btree (application_id, plan_code, device_count, total_kobo) WHERE ((status)::text <> 'cancelled'::text)
CREATE INDEX blocked_ips_active_index ON public.blocked_ips USING btree (ip_address) WHERE (unblocked_at IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX installation_device_assignments_fleet_device_id_unique ON public.installation_device_assignments USING btree (fleet_device_id) WHERE (fleet_device_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX installer_notifications_unread_index ON public.installer_notifications USING btree (installer_id) WHERE (read_at IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX onboarding_application_documents_type_unique ON public.onboarding_application_documents USING btree (application_id, document_type) WHERE (vehicle_id IS NULL)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX onboarding_application_documents_vehicle_type_unique ON public.onboarding_application_documents USING btree (application_id, document_type, vehicle_id) WHERE (vehicle_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX organisation_upgrade_requests_one_open ON public.organisation_upgrade_requests USING btree (tenant_id) WHERE ((status)::text = 'pending'::text)
CREATE INDEX tenant_permission_removals_due_index ON public.tenant_permission_removals USING btree (effective_at) WHERE ((status)::text = 'scheduled'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tenant_roles_tenant_name_unique ON public.tenant_roles USING btree (tenant_id, lower((name)::text))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wallet_ledger_entries_idempotency_unique ON public.wallet_ledger_entries USING btree (tenant_id, idempotency_key) WHERE (idempotency_key IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wallet_top_ups_reference_uidx ON public.wallet_top_ups USING btree (reference) WHERE (reference IS NOT NULL)
